job.title: Sales & Customer Support Specialist
job.description:
Are you naturally curious about cars, confident talking to customers and motivated by achieving great results?

We’re looking for a Sales & Customer Support Specialist to join a leading luxury automotive brand. This is a fantastic opportunity for a switched-on, technically savvy, customer-focused sales professional to step into the world of premium automotive and become an expert across the brand’s exciting vehicle range. 

You’ll be part of a high-performing Business Development Centre, connecting with customers, creating sales opportunities and delivering the kind of premium experience you’d expect from a luxury brand.

What you’ll be doing
  • Become a product expert across the brand’s vehicle range, confidently talking customers through models, features and technology.
  • Engage with customers and understand their needs, preferences and buying journey.
  • Generate and qualify high-quality leads for the dealer network.
  • Follow up with customers and dealers to maximise sales opportunities and conversion.
  • Build strong customer relationships and deliver a consistently premium customer experience.
  • Identify opportunities to progress customers through the sales journey.
  • Capture customer information accurately and maintain up-to-date records in internal systems.
  • Gather customer feedback and share insights to help improve the customer experience.
  • Ensure all interactions comply with relevant Financial Services regulations.
  • Work collaboratively with the wider team to achieve BDC and sales targets.
  • Assist with a range of enquiries and administrative tasks as required.
What we’re looking for

You’ll ideally have experience in sales, customer service, hospitality or a similar customer-facing environment. Automotive experience would be great, but it’s not essential. Experience within a premium or luxury environment will be highly regarded.

Most importantly, you’ll be someone who:
  • Is confident, engaging and enjoys talking to people.
  • Has a genuine passion or strong interest in cars and automotive technology.
  • Tech-savvy with the ability to learn complex systems and explain technical features clearly.
  • Knows how to build rapport and create great customer experiences.
  • Has a natural sales mindset and enjoys identifying opportunities.
  • Communicates clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
  • Is organised, motivated and comfortable working towards targets.
  • Has excellent attention to detail and strong follow-through.
  • Is proactive, curious and keen to learn.
  • Works well as part of a team and takes pride in what they do.
Why join?

This is a great opportunity to get your foot in the door with a globally recognised luxury automotive brand and build your career in an exciting, customer-focused environment.
You’ll enjoy:
  • Working with a prestigious and innovative automotive brand.
  • A dynamic and supportive team environment.
  • Exposure to the luxury automotive and retail industry.
  • The opportunity to develop your sales, product and customer experience skills.
  • 12-month fixed term full time contract with the potential to build valuable long-term industry experience.
If you’re energetic, commercially minded and genuinely love cars and people, we’d love to hear from you.

How to Apply

Please click on the appropriate link and send your resume in Word format.
For a confidential discussion, please contact Alexis Martin on 03 9535 2115

You are a proactive, commercially minded sales professional who understands the construction industry and knows how to turn relationships into business opportunities.

Ideally, you will bring:

  • A strong understanding of the Queensland commercial construction market.

job.title: HR & OHS Manager
job.description:
The Company
 
Established Australian company supporting construction and built-environment projects, working alongside builders, developers and facilities teams from early project phases through to delivery and ongoing upkeep. They position themselves around quality, compliance, and maintaining long-term client relationships across repeat project work.
 
 
The Role
 
The HR & OH&S Manager oversees all HR and workplace health and safety functions, ensuring compliance with relevant legislation and regulations. The role supports a safe, productive, positive culture and manages recruitment, employee relations, training, performance and risk management to support business growth. Key Responsibilities include:
 
  • Lead end-to-end HR operations: recruitment, onboarding, workforce planning, employee relations and HR compliance.
  • Partner with leaders to provide timely HR advice aligned to employment legislation and internal policies.
  • Manage contracts and documentation: employment / contractor agreements, renewals, variations, terminations and record management (HRIS).
  • Coordinate training, inductions and compliance requirements; maintain training and certification / currency records.
  • Support WHS / OH&S systems: policies, procedures, audits and risk assessments (in consultation with the EHSQ Manager).
  • Assist with SWMS development / reviews and ensure safe work practices are followed across sites.
  • Support incident reporting and investigations, tracking actions to close-out within required timeframes.
  • Oversee injury management processes including WorkCover and Return to Work planning.
  • Contribute to ISO / Integrated Management System (IMS) compliance, audits, non-conformance management and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain high professional standards, accurate records and confidentiality with regular site travel as required.
 
 
The Person

You’ll bring, qualifications in HR / Business or WHS, formal WHS certification, and experience in HR (including hands-on WHS systems). You’ll have strong knowledge of Australian employment law and WHS requirements, be confident with MS Office, and communicate clearly at all levels. Construction exposure, system implementation experience, leadership capability, and Cert IV (Quality / Environmental) are highly regarded. Current Victorian driver’s licence essential.
 
You’re organised, detail-focused and comfortable juggling priorities in a fast-paced environment. You build strong relationships, handle sensitive matters professionally, and can navigate and resolve issues calmly and confidently. A proactive, safety-first mindset and the ability to lead training or engagement initiatives will set you apart.
 
You’ll partner closely with Directors and employees (including subcontractors), and engage with principal builders, suppliers / trades, client representatives, unions / employee reps, training providers, and regulatory bodies.
 
To apply online please click on the appropriate link and send your resume in WORD format. Alternatively, for a confidential discussion please contact Jen Schembri on 03 9058 3062
